sloka: अयोध्यायां पुरा राजा युवनाश्वसुतो बली ।मान्धातेति स विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु वीर्यवान् ।। ७.६७.५ ॥
transliteration: ayodhyāyāṁ purā rājā yuvanāśvasuto balī ।māndhāteti sa vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān ।। 7.67.5 ॥

translations.english: Formerly in Ayodhya, there was a powerful king, the son of Yuvanashva, who was renowned as Mandhata and was valorous in the three worlds.
